purpose: Thin r2 wrapper correction for PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json binary64 deserialization of correct dyadic JSON time text; no reader, data, physics, limit, solver or source change.

preserved_failure.interpretation: Completed reader succeeded; r1 outer schedule comparison used transient deserialized JSON doubles rather than integer-step binary time. Stored JSON and native data are not rewritten.

actions.adoption: -Backend CPU -Window coarse -AdoptCompletedReader. Only this already-completed case may be adopted. Rehash prior inputs/files, verify original typed exit0/log/program/argv, passed completion, exact failure, own Run and current closure. Reuse existing native directory and reader_call Entry without invoking a reader or creating a replacement call/log.
actions.normal: Future half/GPU coarse uses one existing reader invocation and fresh *_r2_native output, *_r2_reader.call.json/log and *_r2.native.json. CPU coarse without explicit adoption is rejected to prevent accidental repetition.

contract.reader_call: Actual prior r1 Entry for adoption; actual newly owned r2 Entry for a normal read.
contract.completion: Existing typed reader schema and all original guards retained; no new C++ decoder.

clock.truth: Integer table part/completed_steps/saved_step and native CSV step/dt/time. Wanted time is completed_steps multiplied by locked binary 2^-19 (coarse/smoke) or 2^-20 (half). Time and dt compare binary64 bits exactly. Typed C++ exact native-clock preset guard remains mandatory.
clock.JSON_time: Deserialized row.time_s discrepancy is counted/max-reported only, never used as an acceptance tolerance or as native clock truth. Correct JSON text and actual native storage remain unchanged.
clock.eta0: Original decimal .025s preset and guards unchanged; integer-times-dyadic formula is not applied to eta0.
clock.limits: Original ledger relative error <=5e-13, actual end and signed dterror <=1e-14, samples/IDs/public22/finite/no-exclusion/drainage coverage/13 leaf set unchanged.

downstream: Only coarse/half consumers need new check path/stage. Keep source_run r1, paths.native_dir, reader_call, completion, inputs and files Entry contracts. Do not convert old failed wrapper to passed.
